title: The XTTS Environment
lede: The local engine lives in its own environment. Occasionally you'll update or rebuild it.
body:
At a glance
  • What lives in the engine environment.
  • An update script keeps it current.
  • Recreate it if dependencies go stale.

What lives there

The local engine and its heavy dependencies live separately from the app to avoid conflicts. See The Two Environments.

Updating & recreating

An update script refreshes the engine environment. If dependencies get into a bad state, recreate it without touching the app.
